study.research_question: Does training coverage across12 combinations improve held-out combinations, with fixed24 executed teacher episodes per condition?

teacher_development.reason: Smooth transport failed its predeclared gate; retain legacy teacher to isolate training coverage. All attempts including failures retained.

study.collection_gate: Both groups must have24 qualified lifts and at least20 strict successes out of24; all failures remain in BC dataset. No test or held-out teacher collection.
study.information_boundary: Current RGB/12D robot-goal-past-command vector only; no online object truth, expert phase or external clock. Goal numeric/RGB/scorer agree.
study.personal_data: Both conditions share existing S01 pre-action goal geometry. No new videos or transport profiles used; this is a coverage experiment, not a personal-video-benefit claim.
study.selection: All3 final EMA checkpoints,2500 updates; no checkpoint or seed selection; development reporting then frozen32-case test regardless of comparative direction.
study.budget: Same24 episodes, paired physical initial scenes, model/init/sampling/augmentation/2500updates; trajectory lengths differ so total frame targets and compute can differ.
study.sample_scope: Test32 tasks reuse8 physical object starts across goals and3 training seeds; not96 independent environments per condition.
